mainEntity.name: Is FAICO the same as a clinical fellowship?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. A clinical fellowship or senior residency is a period of training. FAICO is an assessment-based award for an eligible AIOS member in a selected subspecialty.

mainEntity.name: Can I apply immediately after MS or DNB?

acceptedAnswer.text: The degree alone does not meet the published requirements. AIOS also requires post-PG experience and one listed subspecialty experience route.

mainEntity.name: How many FAICO specialties can I take?

acceptedAnswer.text: AIOS says a member may apply for one specialty at a time and may complete a maximum of two specialties.
No. AIOS lists 31 May 2026 as the deadline. This was checked on 17 August 2026.

mainEntity.name: How many questions are in the 2026 written test?

acceptedAnswer.text: The current AIOS page confirms an online MCQ test but does not state the 2026 question count.
That depends on training stage, specialty practice and professional goals. The official exam page does not support guaranteed career outcomes.
